verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships an official in-process Python API with transformers-style `AutoModel`/`AutoConfig`/`AutoEngine` and `AutoEngine.from_pretrained(...)`. It also offers an OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` server, so generic OpenAI or HTTP clients in any language can call it. There is no evidence of an official JavaScript client or a dedicated Edge0 HTTP client SDK, and the Python API is documented only by short snippets. Missing for 10: an official JavaScript/TypeScript client library, an official client SDK for the serve endpoint, and in-depth API reference docs or independent corroboration of the Python library.
